subject: Mutual action plan — milestone owners & signature cutoff
messages:
From: Jordan Moore <jordan.moore@orchardhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Draft mutual action plan & timeline for Redwood pilot

Hi Ben / Monica,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — the team was impressed with the latency profile and the routing/fallback features. Per our call, I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (filename: Redwood-MAP-draft-v0.1.xlsx) with the milestones we talked through. High-level asks: please confirm (1) milestone ownership, (2) any missing technical dependencies (SCIM/SSO, data retention proof), and (3) whether Redwood can commit to a contract signature by the target date below.

Proposed target close / signature: 2026-11-20 (Orchard needs fielding of legal comments and PO issuance before month-end).

Key dependencies listed in the draft:
- Legal review window (Orchard legal): 5 business days
- Procurement PO issuance: 2-3 business days after legal signoff
- SSO/SCIM integration: engineering lead estimated 10 business days but needs API keys from Redwood

Next steps from our side: can Redwood confirm internal milestone owners and whether you can support an accelerated signature (if needed) to 11/18 because Orchard has a board approval window the week after. Also please confirm if you need any pre-signed templates or security evidence (SOC 2 artifacts).

Attachment: Redwood-MAP-draft-v0.1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks,
Jordan
Director, Digital Programs
Orchard Health

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Moore <jordan.moore@orchardhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T13:55:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft mutual action plan & timeline for Redwood pilot

Jordan — appreciate the clear doc and the recap. Quick responses inline and a couple of updates: (see attached updated-map-v0.2.xlsx)

- Target signature: we can plan for 2026-11-20 as the baseline. If Orchard needs an accelerated sign on 2026-11-18 to hit your board window, we will try to accommodate but need to tighten legal review and procurement handoffs.
- Internal owners (Redwood):
  - Commercial owner / contract: Ben Carter (me)
  - Technical integration lead: Monica Patel (cc'd) — will own SCIM/SSO and runtime acceptance
  - Security evidence & SOC2: Rafael Mendes (security) — I'll loop him in if you need artifacts
- Dependencies:
  - API key provisioning: Redwood engineering can provision a staging key within 48 hours of SOW acceptance
  - SCIM: Monica estimates 7-10 business days once we have service account and test tenant

I attached an updated MAP where I pushed a procurement milestone earlier (legal review window to start as soon as we have a countersigned SOW). If Orchard can confirm budget owner and procurement lead (name + email), we'll create a short procurement checklist and route the SOW/quote for signature.

Attachment: updated-map-v0.2.xlsx

I'll hold 11/18 and 11/20 as tentative signature windows; let me know if 11/18 is a hard preference and I'll escalate to Legal to compress review.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Moore <jordan.moore@orchardhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Procurement checklist & SSO/SCIM owner request

Thanks Jordan — looping in a short procurement checklist to make the internal steps explicit. Attaching procurement-checklist.pdf.

Monica here — on the integration side I want to confirm the target test tenant details and the procurement lead to coordinate invoicing: please confirm the following by COB tomorrow if possible:
- Procurement lead (name + email)
- Budget owner / GL code if required by your PO process
- Any vendor form or W9 requirements (we can provide vendor packet)

Integration timeline notes: once we have a test tenant and API keys we can run an initial smoke test within 48 hours and then schedule the SCIM onboarding (7–10 business days). If 11/18 is the desired signature date we need the PO/budget confirmation by 11/12 to meet internal provisioning timelines.

Attachment: procurement-checklist.pdf

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
From: Jordan Moore <jordan.moore@orchardhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T08:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft mutual action plan & timeline for Redwood pilot

Ben / Monica — quick update from Orchard procurement and legal: procurement lead is Alisha Patel (alisha.patel@orchardhealth.com). Budget owner is listed as Tyler Nguyen (tyler.nguyen@orchardhealth.com) and they can issue a PO once legal completes review. Legal indicated a 3 business day review window if we get the SOW and vendor packet today.

One ask: our board is meeting on 2026-11-19 and we'd prefer a signature by 2026-11-18 if Redwood can support that earlier date. Can your team confirm you can compress internal review steps to hit 11/18? If so, we'll prioritize getting the procurement info to you by EOD.

Thanks — Jordan
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Moore <jordan.moore@orchardhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft mutual action plan & timeline for Redwood pilot

Jordan — thanks for the procurement contacts; appreciate the quick turnaround. I spoke with Legal and Security and we can support an 11/18 signature target under the following constraints:

- Redwood will prioritize review and will have a countersigned SOW ready by 11/17 EOD provided Orchard returns the completed vendor packet and any redlines by 11/12 COB.
- Procurement PO needs to land by 11/19 morning (we'll accept PO post-signature but need confirmation for provisioning).
- Monica will start prepping the staging key and SCIM runbook as soon as we receive the test tenant details.

If Orchard confirms commit to the 11/12 deadline for handing over procurement docs, we will escalate internally and aim to hit 11/18 signature. Otherwise we'll fall back to 11/20 as originally proposed.

I'll send a short two-column action table (owner / due date) after this thread to lock responsibilities.

Best,
Ben
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
